text:
Our latest Proof of Reserves snapshot now covers 44 tokens, up from 10, expanding the range of assets users can independently verify are backed at least 1:1.

Generating the full zero-knowledge proof takes 50–60 hours of computation. That’s a long wait, but it serves an important purpose: letting users verify the backing of their own balances, rather than simply taking our word for it.

On recovery, we’re now at ~98% of impacted assets replenished. We’ll continue buying the remaining, less liquid tokens carefully through market and OTC channels to avoid moving prices as we close the gap.

There’s still work ahead: fully reopening withdrawals and strengthening safeguards. I’ll keep sharing progress as we go.
